     ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     The high-speed maglev guideway turnout is a safety-critical cyber-physical mechanism located within a low-pressure
     evacuated vacuum envelope (10.0 to 100.0 mbar). It enables continuous magnetic levitation, lateral guidance, and
     linear synchronous motor (LSM) propulsion across high-speed divergence points without mechanical flange contact.

       - Segment 2 (Intermediate Elastic Transition Girder, 35.0 m): Continuous elastic deformation segment driven by

       - Segment 3 (Frog Nose / Switch Point Section, 20.0 m): High-rigidity box girder terminating at the movable frog
         nose where track continuity is achieved with sub-millimeter geometric tolerance.
     
     Actuation is provided by four preloaded planetary roller screw servo drives (Actuators 1 through 4) arranged in
     dual-redundant tandem pairs with electronic line-shaft cross-coupling synchronization.
     
  2. SUB-MILLIMETER TRACK ALIGNMENT LASER INTERFEROMETRY:
     ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

     Alignment is continuously verified by a Triple-Modular Redundant (2oo3 TMR) heterodyne laser interferometer system:

  3. THERMAL EXPANSION GAP SERVO LOCKING SYSTEM:
     ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     Evacuated tube operating conditions exhibit wide structural temperature excursions (-40 deg C to +75 deg C).
     Without ambient convective air damping, solar and electromagnetic core heating induce substantial axial elongation:
         Delta_L = Sum_i ( alpha_steel * L_segment_i * (T_girder_i - T_ref) )

     To prevent thermal buckling under compression or destructive air gap expansion under contraction, the guideway joints

       - Real-time Position-to-Force (P/Q) control transitions smoothly from gap positioning to high-clamp preload

    iLoopCounter_j                  : INT;              (* General matrix/vector column iteration index *)

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 0: MATRIX COEFFICIENT INITIALIZATION (ONE-SHOT POWER-ON INITIALIZATION)
   Discretized state-space model for coupled articulated 80 m flexible girder with two bending modes and thermal gap.
   Sample period T_s = 0.002 s (2.0 ms). Continuous matrices discretized via 4th-order Taylor series approximation.
==================================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Discrete State Transition Matrix A_d [6x6]:
       x1 = y_frog [mm],  x2 = v_frog [mm/s],  x3 = y_mid [mm],  x4 = v_mid [mm/s],  x5 = Delta_L [mm],  x6 = v_gap [mm/s]
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_A_d[1,1] := 0.999842;  a_A_d[1,2] := 0.001988;  a_A_d[1,3] := 0.000155;  a_A_d[1,4] := 0.000008;  a_A_d[1,5] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[1,6] := 0.000000;
    a_A_d[2,1] := -0.15624;  a_A_d[2,2] := 0.987625;  a_A_d[2,3] := 0.154120;  a_A_d[2,4] := 0.007850;  a_A_d[2,5] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[2,6] := 0.000000;
    a_A_d[3,1] := 0.000085;  a_A_d[3,2] := 0.000004;  a_A_d[3,3] := 0.999712;  a_A_d[3,4] := 0.001975;  a_A_d[3,5] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[3,6] := 0.000000;
    a_A_d[4,1] := 0.084150;  a_A_d[4,2] := 0.004210;  a_A_d[4,3] := -0.28542;  a_A_d[4,4] := 0.974150;  a_A_d[4,5] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[4,6] := 0.000000;
    a_A_d[5,1] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[5,2] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[5,3] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[5,4] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[5,5] := 0.999990;  a_A_d[5,6] := 0.001995;
    a_A_d[6,1] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[6,2] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[6,3] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[6,4] := 0.000000;  a_A_d[6,5] := -0.01050;  a_A_d[6,6] := 0.994800;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Discrete Input Matrix B_d [6x4]:
       Inputs: u1 = F_act1 [kN],  u2 = F_act2 [kN],  u3 = F_act3 [kN],  u4 = F_act4 [kN]
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_B_d[1,1] := 0.0000012; a_B_d[1,2] := 0.0000015; a_B_d[1,3] := 0.0000085; a_B_d[1,4] := 0.0000092;
    a_B_d[2,1] := 0.0011500; a_B_d[2,2] := 0.0014200; a_B_d[2,3] := 0.0084500; a_B_d[2,4] := 0.0091200;
    a_B_d[3,1] := 0.0000065; a_B_d[3,2] := 0.0000072; a_B_d[3,3] := 0.0000021; a_B_d[3,4] := 0.0000019;
    a_B_d[4,1] := 0.0064200; a_B_d[4,2] := 0.0071500; a_B_d[4,3] := 0.0020500; a_B_d[4,4] := 0.0018800;
    a_B_d[5,1] := 0.0000001; a_B_d[5,2] := 0.0000001; a_B_d[5,3] := 0.0000002; a_B_d[5,4] := 0.0000002;
    a_B_d[6,1] := 0.0000850; a_B_d[6,2] := 0.0000850; a_B_d[6,3] := 0.0001250; a_B_d[6,4] := 0.0001250;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Discrete Output Matrix C_d [2x6]:
       Outputs: y1 = y_frog [mm],  y2 = Delta_L [mm]
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_C_d[1,1] := 1.000; a_C_d[1,2] := 0.000; a_C_d[1,3] := 0.000; a_C_d[1,4] := 0.000; a_C_d[1,5] := 0.000; a_C_d[1,6] := 0.000;
    a_C_d[2,1] := 0.000; a_C_d[2,2] := 0.000; a_C_d[2,3] := 0.000; a_C_d[2,4] := 0.000; a_C_d[2,5] := 1.000; a_C_d[2,6] := 0.000;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Discrete Direct Feedthrough Matrix D_d [2x4]:
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_D_d[1,1] := 0.000; a_D_d[1,2] := 0.000; a_D_d[1,3] := 0.000; a_D_d[1,4] := 0.000;
    a_D_d[2,1] := 0.000; a_D_d[2,2] := 0.000; a_D_d[2,3] := 0.000; a_D_d[2,4] := 0.000;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Discrete Steady-State Kalman Observer Gain Matrix L_obs [6x2]:
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_L_obs[1,1] := 0.1852; a_L_obs[1,2] := 0.0000;
    a_L_obs[2,1] := 4.2500; a_L_obs[2,2] := 0.0000;
    a_L_obs[3,1] := 0.0950; a_L_obs[3,2] := 0.0000;
    a_L_obs[4,1] := 1.8200; a_L_obs[4,2] := 0.0000;
    a_L_obs[5,1] := 0.0000; a_L_obs[5,2] := 0.1450;
    a_L_obs[6,1] := 0.0000; a_L_obs[6,2] := 3.1200;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       MPC Objective Function Penalties & Hessian Diagonal Approximation
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_MPC_Weight_Q[1] := 250.0;     (* Heavy penalty on frog nose lateral positioning error *)
    a_MPC_Weight_Q[2] := 80.0;      (* Penalty on thermal expansion gap tracking error *)
    
    a_MPC_Weight_R[1] := 0.045;     (* Actuator 1 thrust slew rate penalty *)
    a_MPC_Weight_R[2] := 0.045;     (* Actuator 2 thrust slew rate penalty *)
    a_MPC_Weight_R[3] := 0.055;     (* Actuator 3 thrust slew rate penalty *)
    a_MPC_Weight_R[4] := 0.055;     (* Actuator 4 thrust slew rate penalty *)

    (* Initialize diagonal Hessian elements for N_c = 3 control horizon (12 control variables) *)
    FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 12 DO
        a_Hessian_Diag[iLoopCounter_i] := 0.125 + (INT_TO_REAL(iLoopCounter_i MOD 4) * 0.020);
    END_FOR;

    (* Wedge Mechanical Advantage Ratio: tan(theta + phi) where theta = 7.125 deg, phi = atan(mu = 0.085) = 4.858 deg *)
    (* Total friction-included angle = 11.983 deg -> tan(11.983 deg) = 0.2122 -> Advantage = 1 / 0.2122 = 4.712 *)
    rWedgeMechanicalAdvantage := 4.712;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 1: HARD SAFETY INTERLOCK EVALUATION & ALARM TRIP CHECKS (SIL 4 ARCHITECTURE)
   Evaluates physical E-stop safety circuit, chamber vacuum integrity, and dynamic vibration levels.
==================================================================================================================== *)
wAlarmCode_HighSeverity  := 0;
wWarningCode_LowSeverity := 0;

(* Check E-Stop Loop *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

(* Check Vacuum Envelope Pressure Integrity *)
IF (rChamberPressure_mbar < c_rMinVacuumPressure_mbar) OR (rChamberPressure_mbar > c_rMaxVacuumPressure_mbar) THEN
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.1 := TRUE; (* Bit 1: Evacuated Tube Pressure Loss / Breach *)
END_IF;

(* Check Triaxial Vibration & Seismic Acceleration *)
rNormAcc := SQRT((rTriaxialVib_X_ms2 * rTriaxialVib_X_ms2) + 
                 (rTriaxialVib_Y_ms2 * rTriaxialVib_Y_ms2) + 
                 (rTriaxialVib_Z_ms2 * rTriaxialVib_Z_ms2));

IF rNormAcc > c_rMaxAllowableVib_ms2 THEN
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.2 := TRUE; (* Bit 2: Excessive Dynamic Guideway Vibration (> 0.25 g) *)
END_IF;

(* Check Guideway Angular Torsion / Inclination *)
IF (ABS(rGirderTilt_Roll_deg) > 0.450) OR (ABS(rGirderTilt_Pitch_deg) > 0.350) THEN
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.3 := TRUE; (* Bit 3: Guideway Structural Torsion / Tilt Exceeded *)
END_IF;

(* Train Approaching Inhibit Violation *)
IF bTrainApproachingInhibit AND bMotionInProgress THEN
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.4 := TRUE; (* Bit 4: Motion In Progress while Train Approaching Inhibit Active! *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 2: SUB-MILLIMETER 2oo3 TMR LASER INTERFEROMETRY METROLOGY & REFRACTIVE INDEX COMPENSATION
   Heterodyne laser wavelength corrected for vacuum residual pressure and chamber temperature via Edlen equation.
==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Refractivity compensation factor calculation: n(P, T) *)
rLaserA_Corrected_mm := rLaserDist_ChA_mm * (1.0 + (2.879E-7 * rChamberPressure_mbar * (293.15 / (273.15 + rAmbientTubeTemp_degC))));
rLaserB_Corrected_mm := rLaserDist_ChB_mm * (1.0 + (2.879E-7 * rChamberPressure_mbar * (293.15 / (273.15 + rAmbientTubeTemp_degC))));
rLaserC_Corrected_mm := rLaserDist_ChC_mm * (1.0 + (2.879E-7 * rChamberPressure_mbar * (293.15 / (273.15 + rAmbientTubeTemp_degC))));

(* Pairwise Parity Residuals *)
rLaserParity_AB_mm := ABS(rLaserA_Corrected_mm - rLaserB_Corrected_mm);
rLaserParity_BC_mm := ABS(rLaserB_Corrected_mm - rLaserC_Corrected_mm);
rLaserParity_CA_mm := ABS(rLaserC_Corrected_mm - rLaserA_Corrected_mm);

(* Channel Integrity Diagnostics *)
bLaserChA_Valid := (rLaserParity_AB_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm) OR (rLaserParity_CA_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm);
bLaserChB_Valid := (rLaserParity_AB_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm) OR (rLaserParity_BC_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm);
bLaserChC_Valid := (rLaserParity_BC_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm) OR (rLaserParity_CA_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm);

(* Count Valid Channels *)
iLaserHealthyCount := 0;
IF bLaserChA_Valid THEN iLaserHealthyCount := iLaserHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLaserChB_Valid THEN iLaserHealthyCount := iLaserHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLaserChC_Valid THEN iLaserHealthyCount := iLaserHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 TMR Voting Algorithm *)
IF iLaserHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Full Triple Redundancy: Median Voting *)
    IF ((rLaserA_Corrected_mm >= rLaserB_Corrected_mm) AND (rLaserA_Corrected_mm <= rLaserC_Corrected_mm)) OR
       ((rLaserA_Corrected_mm >= rLaserC_Corrected_mm) AND (rLaserA_Corrected_mm <= rLaserB_Corrected_mm)) THEN
        rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm := rLaserA_Corrected_mm;
    ELSIF ((rLaserB_Corrected_mm >= rLaserA_Corrected_mm) AND (rLaserB_Corrected_mm <= rLaserC_Corrected_mm)) OR
          ((rLaserB_Corrected_mm >= rLaserC_Corrected_mm) AND (rLaserB_Corrected_mm <= rLaserA_Corrected_mm)) THEN
        rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm := rLaserB_Corrected_mm;
    ELSE
        rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm := rLaserC_Corrected_mm;
    END_IF;
    bLaserInterferometerHealthy := TRUE;
ELSIF iLaserHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded Dual Redundancy: Mean of Valid Pair *)
    IF bLaserChA_Valid AND bLaserChB_Valid THEN
        rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm := 0.5 * (rLaserA_Corrected_mm + rLaserB_Corrected_mm);
    ELSIF bLaserChB_Valid AND bLaserChC_Valid THEN
        rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm := 0.5 * (rLaserB_Corrected_mm + rLaserC_Corrected_mm);
    ELSE
        rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm := 0.5 * (rLaserA_Corrected_mm + rLaserC_Corrected_mm);
    END_IF;
    bLaserInterferometerHealthy := TRUE;
    wWarningCode_LowSeverity.0 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 0: Laser TMR Degraded to 1oo2 *)
ELSE
    (* Critical Failure: Total Discrepancy Trip *)
    bLaserInterferometerHealthy := FALSE;
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.5 := TRUE; (* Bit 5: 2oo3 Laser Alignment Sensor Plausibility Failure *)
    rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm := a_State_x[1]; (* Fallback to observer estimate *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Expansion Gap 2oo3 Laser Sensor Processing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm := rLaserGap_ChA_mm;
rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm := rLaserGap_ChB_mm;
rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm := rLaserGap_ChC_mm;

rGapParity_AB_mm := ABS(rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm - rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm);
rGapParity_BC_mm := ABS(rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm - rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm);
rGapParity_CA_mm := ABS(rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm - rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm);

bGapChA_Valid := (rGapParity_AB_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm) OR (rGapParity_CA_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm);
bGapChB_Valid := (rGapParity_AB_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm) OR (rGapParity_BC_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm);
bGapChC_Valid := (rGapParity_BC_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm) OR (rGapParity_CA_mm <= c_rMaxDiscrepancyLaser_mm);

iGapHealthyCount := 0;
IF bGapChA_Valid THEN iGapHealthyCount := iGapHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bGapChB_Valid THEN iGapHealthyCount := iGapHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bGapChC_Valid THEN iGapHealthyCount := iGapHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iGapHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm >= rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm) AND (rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm <= rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm)) OR
       ((rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm >= rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm) AND (rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm <= rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm)) THEN
        rExpansionGapVoted_mm := rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm;
    ELSIF ((rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm >= rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm) AND (rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm <= rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm)) OR
          ((rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm >= rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm) AND (rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm <= rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm)) THEN
        rExpansionGapVoted_mm := rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm;
    ELSE
        rExpansionGapVoted_mm := rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iGapHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bGapChA_Valid AND bGapChB_Valid THEN
        rExpansionGapVoted_mm := 0.5 * (rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm + rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm);
    ELSIF bGapChB_Valid AND bGapChC_Valid THEN
        rExpansionGapVoted_mm := 0.5 * (rGapLaserB_Corrected_mm + rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm);
    ELSE
        rExpansionGapVoted_mm := 0.5 * (rGapLaserA_Corrected_mm + rGapLaserC_Corrected_mm);
    END_IF;
    wWarningCode_LowSeverity.1 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 1: Gap Laser Degraded to 1oo2 *)
ELSE
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.6 := TRUE; (* Bit 6: 2oo3 Gap Laser Sensor Failure *)
    rExpansionGapVoted_mm := a_State_x[5];
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 3: THERMO-ELASTIC EXPANSION CALCULATION & EXPANSION GAP SYNTHESIS
   Computes physical thermal strain across the three structural girder segments (L1=25m, L2=35m, L3=20m).
==================================================================================================================== *)
rGirderAvgTemp_degC := (0.3125 * rGirderTemp_Seg1_degC) + 
                       (0.4375 * rGirderTemp_Seg2_degC) + 
                       (0.2500 * rGirderTemp_Seg3_degC);

rDeltaTemp_degC := rGirderAvgTemp_degC - c_rRefTemp_degC;

(* Theoretical elongation: Delta_L = alpha * L_0 * Delta_T *)
rCalculatedThermalDelta_mm := c_rSteelCTE * (c_rTotalGirderLength_m * 1000.0) * rDeltaTemp_degC;
rCalculatedThermalExpansion_mm := rCalculatedThermalDelta_mm;

(* Target neutral gap dimension dynamically adjusted for structural temperature *)
rTargetGapWidth_mm := c_rNominalGap_mm - rCalculatedThermalDelta_mm;
rGapPositionError_mm := rExpansionGapVoted_mm - rTargetGapWidth_mm;

(* Check Thermal Gradient Alert *)
IF (ABS(rGirderTemp_Seg1_degC - rGirderTemp_Seg2_degC) > 8.0) OR 
   (ABS(rGirderTemp_Seg2_degC - rGirderTemp_Seg3_degC) > 8.0) THEN
    wWarningCode_LowSeverity.2 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 2: High Inter-Segment Thermal Gradient *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 4: DISCRETE KALMAN STATE-SPACE OBSERVER UPDATE
   Estimates unmeasured modal velocities and state vectors:
     x_hat[k|k] = x_hat[k|k-1] + L_obs * ( y_meas[k] - C_d * x_hat[k|k-1] )
     x_hat[k+1|k] = A_d * x_hat[k|k] + B_d * u[k]
==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Compute Innovation: y_meas - C_d * x_pred *)
a_Obs_Innovation[1] := rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm - (a_C_d[1,1] * a_State_x_pred[1] + a_C_d[1,5] * a_State_x_pred[5]);
a_Obs_Innovation[2] := rExpansionGapVoted_mm - (a_C_d[2,1] * a_State_x_pred[1] + a_C_d[2,5] * a_State_x_pred[5]);

(* Innovation Correction Update *)
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 6 DO
    a_State_x[iLoopCounter_i] := a_State_x_pred[iLoopCounter_i] + 
                                 (a_L_obs[iLoopCounter_i, 1] * a_Obs_Innovation[1]) + 
                                 (a_L_obs[iLoopCounter_i, 2] * a_Obs_Innovation[2]);
END_FOR;

(* Map Observer Outputs *)
rObservedState_YFrog_mm     := a_State_x[1];
rObservedState_VeloFrog_mms := a_State_x[2];

(* A Priori State Prediction for Next Sample: x_pred = A_d * x + B_d * u *)
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rMatrixAcc := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCounter_j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rMatrixAcc := rMatrixAcc + (a_A_d[iLoopCounter_i, iLoopCounter_j] * a_State_x[iLoopCounter_j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iLoopCounter_k := 1 TO 4 DO
        rMatrixAcc := rMatrixAcc + (a_B_d[iLoopCounter_i, iLoopCounter_k] * a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_k]);
    END_FOR;
    a_State_x_pred[iLoopCounter_i] := rMatrixAcc;
END_FOR;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 5: ELECTRONIC LINE-SHAFT CROSS-COUPLING SYNCHRONIZATION & FRICTION FEEDFORWARD
   Couples Actuators 1, 2, 3, 4 into a virtual electronic line-shaft to eliminate structural torsion and binding.
==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Individual Axis Tracking Errors Relative to Frog Profile Setpoint *)
rError_Act1_mm := rTraj_SetPos_mm * 0.250 - rBallScrewPos_Act1_mm;
rError_Act2_mm := rTraj_SetPos_mm * 0.250 - rBallScrewPos_Act2_mm;
rError_Act3_mm := rTraj_SetPos_mm * 1.000 - rBallScrewPos_Act3_mm;
rError_Act4_mm := rTraj_SetPos_mm * 1.000 - rBallScrewPos_Act4_mm;

(* Cross-Coupling Skew Computations *)
rSyncError_Pair12_mm := rBallScrewPos_Act1_mm - rBallScrewPos_Act2_mm;
rSyncError_Pair34_mm := rBallScrewPos_Act3_mm - rBallScrewPos_Act4_mm;
rSyncError_Tilt_mm   := (0.5 * (rBallScrewPos_Act1_mm + rBallScrewPos_Act2_mm) * 4.0) - 
                        (0.5 * (rBallScrewPos_Act3_mm + rBallScrewPos_Act4_mm));

rSyncError_CrossCoupled_mm := MAX(ABS(rSyncError_Pair12_mm), MAX(ABS(rSyncError_Pair34_mm), ABS(rSyncError_Tilt_mm * 0.25)));

IF rSyncError_CrossCoupled_mm > rPeakSyncErrorRecorded_mm THEN
    rPeakSyncErrorRecorded_mm := rSyncError_CrossCoupled_mm;
END_IF;

(* SIL 4 Cross-Coupling Skew Limit Trip *)
IF rSyncError_CrossCoupled_mm > c_rMaxSyncError_mm THEN
    wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.7 := TRUE; (* Bit 7: Excessive Inter-Segment Cross-Coupling Skew Trip *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QP HILDRETH OPTIMIZATION
   Computes optimal thrust commands over horizon N_p = 5, N_c = 3 to satisfy actuator thrust & slew limits.
==================================================================================================================== *)
IF bTraj_Active AND (wAlarmCode_HighSeverity = 0) THEN
    (* Populate target trajectory across 5 prediction steps *)
    FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 5 DO
        a_MPC_TargetTrajectory[iLoopCounter_i, 1] := rTraj_SetPos_mm + (INT_TO_REAL(iLoopCounter_i) * rTraj_SetVel_mms * rCycleTime_s);
        a_MPC_TargetTrajectory[iLoopCounter_i, 2] := rTargetGapWidth_mm;
    END_FOR;

    (* Compute QP Gradient Vector g = Phi^T * Q * (F * x_hat - Reference) *)
    FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 12 DO
        iLoopCounter_j := ((iLoopCounter_i - 1) MOD 4) + 1;
        a_Gradient_Vector[iLoopCounter_i] := 0.25 * (a_State_x[1] - a_MPC_TargetTrajectory[1, 1]) * a_MPC_Weight_Q[1] + 
                                            (a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_j] * a_MPC_Weight_R[iLoopCounter_j]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Hildreth Dual Active-Set QP Optimization Loop (Deterministic 6 iterations) *)
    FOR iQP_IterationCount := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 12 DO
            (* Unconstrained Step *)
            a_Delta_u_Optimal[iLoopCounter_i] := - a_Gradient_Vector[iLoopCounter_i] / a_Hessian_Diag[iLoopCounter_i];
            
            (* Slew Rate Clamping: Delta_u_max = 25.0 kN/scan *)
            IF a_Delta_u_Optimal[iLoopCounter_i] > 25.0 THEN
                a_Delta_u_Optimal[iLoopCounter_i] := 25.0;
            ELSIF a_Delta_u_Optimal[iLoopCounter_i] < -25.0 THEN
                a_Delta_u_Optimal[iLoopCounter_i] := -25.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply First Horizon Step Increments to Actuators 1..4 *)
    FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 4 DO
        a_Control_u_Previous[iLoopCounter_i] := a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i];
        a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i]  := a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i] + a_Delta_u_Optimal[iLoopCounter_i];

        (* Hard Saturation Envelope: +/- 220.0 kN *)
        IF a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i] > c_rMaxThrust_kN THEN
            a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i] := c_rMaxThrust_kN;
        ELSIF a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i] < -c_rMaxThrust_kN THEN
            a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i] := -c_rMaxThrust_kN;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Quiescent Hold Thrust Commands *)
    FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 4 DO
        a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* Track Peak Actuator Thrust Recorded *)
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    IF ABS(a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i]) > rPeakThrustRecorded_kN THEN
        rPeakThrustRecorded_kN := ABS(a_Control_u_Current[iLoopCounter_i]);
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 7: VIRTUAL MASTER S-CURVE 7TH-ORDER TRAJECTORY GENERATOR
   Generates smooth, analytical position, velocity, and acceleration profiles with continuous jerk and snap:
     s(tau) = 35*tau^4 - 84*tau^5 + 70*tau^6 - 20*tau^7, where tau = t / T_total
==================================================================================================================== *)
IF bTraj_Active THEN
    rTraj_TimeElapsed_s := rTraj_TimeElapsed_s + rCycleTime_s;
    
    IF rTraj_TimeElapsed_s >= rTraj_TotalDuration_s THEN
        rTraj_SetPos_mm  := rTraj_EndPos_mm;
        rTraj_SetVel_mms := 0.0;
        rTraj_SetAcc_mms2:= 0.0;
        bTraj_Active     := FALSE;
        bTraj_Complete   := TRUE;
    ELSE
        (* Normalized Time Variable: tau in [0.0, 1.0] *)
        rMatrixAcc := rTraj_TimeElapsed_s / rTraj_TotalDuration_s; (* tau *)
        
        (* 7th-order polynomial evaluation *)
        rNormAcc := (rTraj_EndPos_mm - rTraj_StartPos_mm);
        rTraj_SetPos_mm := rTraj_StartPos_mm + rNormAcc * (
                           35.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 4) - 
                           84.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 5) + 
                           70.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 6) - 
                           20.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 7));
                           
        rTraj_SetVel_mms := (rNormAcc / rTraj_TotalDuration_s) * (
                            140.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 3) - 
                            420.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 4) + 
                            420.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 5) - 
                            140.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 6));
                            
        rTraj_SetAcc_mms2 := (rNormAcc / EXPT(rTraj_TotalDuration_s, 2)) * (
                             420.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 2) - 
                             1680.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 3) + 
                             2100.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 4) - 
                             840.0 * EXPT(rMatrixAcc, 5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Residual Alignment Error Against Target Rail *)
IF iTargetRoute = 1 THEN
    rAlignmentError_SubMm := rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm - c_rTargetPos_Main_mm;
ELSIF iTargetRoute = 2 THEN
    rAlignmentError_SubMm := rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm - c_rTargetPos_Branch_mm;
ELSE
    rAlignmentError_SubMm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 8: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF)
   Comprehensive operational sequence coordinating gap unlocking, trajectory traversal, sub-millimeter settling,
   servo wedge lock insertion, and safety verification.
==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Emergency Interlock Override Check *)
IF (wAlarmCode_HighSeverity <> 0) AND (iState <> 999) THEN
    iStatePrev := iState;
    iState     := 999; (* Transition immediately to Emergency Fail-Safe Stop *)
END_IF;

CASE iState OF

    0: (* ==================== STATE 0: POWER-ON SELF-TEST & METROLOGY INITIALIZATION ==================== *)
        bRouteLockedMain        := FALSE;
        bRouteLockedBranch      := FALSE;
        bMotionInProgress       := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rLockServoCmd_Main_kN   := 0.0;
        rLockServoCmd_Branch_kN := 0.0;
        
        rPOSTTimer_s := rPOSTTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        
        (* Verify Safety, Vacuum, Laser Health, and Stable Readings for at least 1.5 s *)
        IF (rPOSTTimer_s >= 1.500) AND bSystemEnable AND bEStopOk AND bLaserInterferometerHealthy THEN
            rPOSTTimer_s := 0.0;
            (* Determine starting physical location based on laser feedback *)
            IF ABS(rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm - c_rTargetPos_Main_mm) <= c_rAlignTol_Lock_mm THEN
                iTargetRoute := 1;
                iState := 10; (* Already seated on Main Line -> Jump to Main Locked Idle *)
            ELSIF ABS(rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm - c_rTargetPos_Branch_mm) <= c_rAlignTol_Lock_mm THEN
                iTargetRoute := 2;
                iState := 70; (* Already seated on Branch Turnout -> Jump to Branch Locked Idle *)
            ELSE
                (* Unknown Mid-Span Position: Require deliberate operator homing sequence *)
                iTargetRoute := 1;
                iState := 15; (* Transition to Pre-Move Alignment Verification *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* ==================== STATE 10: IDLE LOCKED ON MAIN LINE (600 KM/H PERMISSIVE) ==================== *)
        bRouteLockedMain        := TRUE;
        bRouteLockedBranch      := FALSE;
        bMotionInProgress       := FALSE;
        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        
        (* Maintain Wedge Clamp Force on Main Line Deadbolts *)
        rLockServoCmd_Main_kN   := c_rClampTargetForce_kN;
        rLockServoCmd_Branch_kN := 0.0;

        (* Check for Divergence Request to Branch Line *)
        IF bRequestRouteBranch AND NOT bTrainApproachingInhibit AND bSystemEnable THEN
            iTargetRoute := 2;
            rLockTimeoutTimer_s := 0.0;
            iState := 20; (* Initiate Unlocking of Main Line Expansion Gaps *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* ==================== STATE 20: UNLOCKING EXPANSION GAPS (MAIN LINE RETRACTION) ==================== *)
        bRouteLockedMain        := FALSE;
        bMotionInProgress       := TRUE;
        rLockServoCmd_Main_kN   := -45.0; (* Retract command on servo wedge deadbolts *)
        rLockTimeoutTimer_s     := rLockTimeoutTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Check Wedge Retraction Sensor Confirmation *)
        bWedgeMainFullyRetracted := (rLockPinPosition_Main_mm <= 5.0) AND (rLockPinForce_Main_kN <= 1.5);

        IF bWedgeMainFullyRetracted THEN
            rLockTimeoutTimer_s := 0.0;
            iState := 30; (* Gaps verified free -> Compute Trajectory & Start Traversal *)
        ELSIF rLockTimeoutTimer_s > 4.500 THEN
            wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.8 := TRUE; (* Bit 8: Main Line Wedge Lock Retraction Timeout *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    30: (* ==================== STATE 30: TRAJECTORY PLANNING & CROSS-COUPLING SETUP ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress       := TRUE;
        rTraj_StartPos_mm       := rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm;
        rTraj_EndPos_mm         := c_rTargetPos_Branch_mm;
        rTraj_TimeElapsed_s     := 0.000;
        
        (* Compute Profile Duration: Total displacement 1250 mm @ V_max = 120 mm/s, Acc = 45 mm/s2 -> ~14.8 s *)
        rTraj_TotalDuration_s   := 14.850;
        bTraj_Active            := TRUE;
        bTraj_Complete          := FALSE;
        iState := 40; (* Enter Synchronized Traversal State *)

    40: (* ==================== STATE 40: SYNCHRONIZED TRAVERSAL (MAIN -> BRANCH) ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress := TRUE;

        (* Virtual Line-Shaft Velocity Feedforward with Cross-Coupling Correction *)
        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 0.250) + 
                                       (rError_Act1_mm * 1.20) - 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair12_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);
                                       
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 0.250) + 
                                       (rError_Act2_mm * 1.20) + 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair12_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);
                                       
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 1.000) + 
                                       (rError_Act3_mm * 1.20) - 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair34_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);
                                       
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 1.000) + 
                                       (rError_Act4_mm * 1.20) + 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair34_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);

        (* Check Trajectory Completion *)
        IF bTraj_Complete THEN
            rFineSettleTimer_s := 0.000;
            iState := 50; (* Traversal complete -> Enter Sub-Millimeter Fine Settling *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* ==================== STATE 50: SUB-MILLIMETER FINE INTERFEROMETRIC SETTLING ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress := TRUE;
        rFineSettleTimer_s := rFineSettleTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Fine Closed-Loop Positioning utilizing 2oo3 Laser Interferometer Feedback *)
        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 0.250) * 1.85;
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 0.250) * 1.85;
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 1.000) * 2.45;
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 1.000) * 2.45;

        (* Check Sub-Millimeter Tolerance Satisfaction (< 0.050 mm) for at least 0.500 s *)
        IF (ABS(rAlignmentError_SubMm) <= c_rAlignTol_Fine_mm) AND 
           (rObservedState_VeloFrog_mms <= 0.50) THEN
            IF rFineSettleTimer_s >= 0.500 THEN
                rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rLockTimeoutTimer_s := 0.0;
                iState := 60; (* Fine alignment achieved -> Drive Branch Locking Wedges *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rFineSettleTimer_s := 0.000;
        END_IF;

        (* Settle Timeout Guard *)
        IF rFineSettleTimer_s > 6.000 THEN
            wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.9 := TRUE; (* Bit 9: Fine Interferometric Settling Timeout *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    60: (* ==================== STATE 60: LOCKING EXPANSION GAPS (BRANCH LINE CLAMPING) ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress       := TRUE;
        rLockServoCmd_Branch_kN := c_rClampTargetForce_kN; (* Drive servo wedge deadbolts to 180 kN *)
        rLockTimeoutTimer_s     := rLockTimeoutTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Verify Full Clamp Seating: Stroke and Force Threshold *)
        bWedgeBranchFullyLocked := (rLockPinPosition_Branch_mm >= (c_rLockPinStroke_mm - 5.0)) AND 
                                   (rLockPinForce_Branch_kN >= (c_rClampTargetForce_kN * 0.90));

        IF bWedgeBranchFullyLocked THEN
            rStateTimer_s := 0.000;
            iState := 65; (* Wedge fully clamped -> Post-Lock Rigidity Verification *)
        ELSIF rLockTimeoutTimer_s > 5.500 THEN
            wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.10 := TRUE; (* Bit 10: Branch Wedge Clamping Timeout / Incomplete Seating *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    65: (* ==================== STATE 65: POST-LOCK ALIGNMENT & STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY CHECK ==================== *)
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        
        (* Maintain Wedge Clamp Force *)
        rLockServoCmd_Branch_kN := c_rClampTargetForce_kN;

        (* Verify Final Laser Residual Remains Below Structural Transit Limit (< 0.150 mm) under clamp stress *)
        IF rStateTimer_s >= 0.800 THEN
            IF ABS(rAlignmentError_SubMm) <= c_rAlignTol_Lock_mm THEN
                iState := 70; (* Alignment verified rigid -> Grant Branch Route Permissive *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.11 := TRUE; (* Bit 11: Post-Clamp Laser Alignment Distortion *)
                iState := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    70: (* ==================== STATE 70: IDLE LOCKED ON BRANCH TURNOUT (600 KM/H PERMISSIVE) ==================== *)
        bRouteLockedMain        := FALSE;
        bRouteLockedBranch      := TRUE;
        bMotionInProgress       := FALSE;
        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        
        (* Maintain Active Clamping Force on Branch Wedges *)
        rLockServoCmd_Branch_kN := c_rClampTargetForce_kN;
        rLockServoCmd_Main_kN   := 0.0;

        (* Check for Return Command to Main Line *)
        IF bRequestRouteMain AND NOT bTrainApproachingInhibit AND bSystemEnable THEN
            iTargetRoute := 1;
            rLockTimeoutTimer_s := 0.0;
            iState := 75; (* Initiate Unlocking of Branch Line Expansion Gaps *)
        END_IF;

    75: (* ==================== STATE 75: UNLOCKING EXPANSION GAPS (BRANCH LINE RETRACTION) ==================== *)
        bRouteLockedBranch      := FALSE;
        bMotionInProgress       := TRUE;
        rLockServoCmd_Branch_kN := -45.0; (* Retract command on Branch wedge deadbolts *)
        rLockTimeoutTimer_s     := rLockTimeoutTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        bWedgeBranchFullyRetracted := (rLockPinPosition_Branch_mm <= 5.0) AND (rLockPinForce_Branch_kN <= 1.5);

        IF bWedgeBranchFullyRetracted THEN
            rLockTimeoutTimer_s := 0.0;
            iState := 80; (* Wedges clear -> Setup Reverse Trajectory to Main Line *)
        ELSIF rLockTimeoutTimer_s > 4.500 THEN
            wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.12 := TRUE; (* Bit 12: Branch Wedge Lock Retraction Timeout *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    80: (* ==================== STATE 80: REVERSE TRAJECTORY PLANNING (BRANCH -> MAIN) ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress       := TRUE;
        rTraj_StartPos_mm       := rFrogNoseVotedPos_mm;
        rTraj_EndPos_mm         := c_rTargetPos_Main_mm;
        rTraj_TimeElapsed_s     := 0.000;
        rTraj_TotalDuration_s   := 14.850;
        bTraj_Active            := TRUE;
        bTraj_Complete          := FALSE;
        iState := 85; (* Enter Reverse Traversal *)

    85: (* ==================== STATE 85: SYNCHRONIZED REVERSE TRAVERSAL (BRANCH -> MAIN) ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress := TRUE;

        (* Reverse Line-Shaft Velocity Feedforward with Cross-Coupling Correction *)
        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 0.250) + 
                                       (rError_Act1_mm * 1.20) - 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair12_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);
                                       
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 0.250) + 
                                       (rError_Act2_mm * 1.20) + 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair12_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);
                                       
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 1.000) + 
                                       (rError_Act3_mm * 1.20) - 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair34_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);
                                       
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := (rTraj_SetVel_mms * 1.000) + 
                                       (rError_Act4_mm * 1.20) + 
                                       (rSyncError_Pair34_mm * rCrossCouplingGain_Kp);

        IF bTraj_Complete THEN
            rFineSettleTimer_s := 0.000;
            iState := 90; (* Traversal complete -> Enter Main Line Fine Settling *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* ==================== STATE 90: SUB-MILLIMETER FINE SETTLING ON MAIN LINE ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress := TRUE;
        rFineSettleTimer_s := rFineSettleTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 0.250) * 1.85;
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 0.250) * 1.85;
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 1.000) * 2.45;
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := - (rAlignmentError_SubMm * 1.000) * 2.45;

        IF (ABS(rAlignmentError_SubMm) <= c_rAlignTol_Fine_mm) AND 
           (rObservedState_VeloFrog_mms <= 0.50) THEN
            IF rFineSettleTimer_s >= 0.500 THEN
                rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
                rLockTimeoutTimer_s := 0.0;
                iState := 95; (* Fine alignment achieved -> Drive Main Locking Wedges *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rFineSettleTimer_s := 0.000;
        END_IF;

        IF rFineSettleTimer_s > 6.000 THEN
            wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.9 := TRUE;
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    95: (* ==================== STATE 95: LOCKING EXPANSION GAPS (MAIN LINE CLAMPING) ==================== *)
        bMotionInProgress     := TRUE;
        rLockServoCmd_Main_kN := c_rClampTargetForce_kN;
        rLockTimeoutTimer_s   := rLockTimeoutTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        bWedgeMainFullyLocked := (rLockPinPosition_Main_mm >= (c_rLockPinStroke_mm - 5.0)) AND 
                                 (rLockPinForce_Main_kN >= (c_rClampTargetForce_kN * 0.90));

        IF bWedgeMainFullyLocked THEN
            rStateTimer_s := 0.000;
            iState := 98; (* Main wedge locked -> Post-Lock Verification *)
        ELSIF rLockTimeoutTimer_s > 5.500 THEN
            wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.13 := TRUE; (* Bit 13: Main Wedge Clamping Timeout *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    98: (* ==================== STATE 98: POST-LOCK ALIGNMENT VERIFICATION ON MAIN LINE ==================== *)
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rLockServoCmd_Main_kN := c_rClampTargetForce_kN;

        IF rStateTimer_s >= 0.800 THEN
            IF ABS(rAlignmentError_SubMm) <= c_rAlignTol_Lock_mm THEN
                iState := 10; (* Seated and rigid -> Return to Main Locked Idle *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmCode_HighSeverity.11 := TRUE;
                iState := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    900: (* ==================== STATE 900: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION (LIMP MODE ACCOMMODATION) ==================== *)
        (* Executed when one ball screw actuator drive trips; remaining three actuators carry re-allocated load *)
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        bMotionInProgress   := TRUE;
        wWarningCode_LowSeverity.3 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 3: Operating under Limp Mode Actuator Redistribution *)

        (* Reduced traverse velocity (35 mm/s) to avoid thermal overload on remaining functional drives *)
        rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms * 0.30;
        rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms * 0.30;
        rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms * 0.30;
        rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms * 0.30;

        IF bTraj_Complete THEN
            iState := 50; (* Transition to fine settle once target reached *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* ==================== STATE 999: EMERGENCY FAIL-SAFE DECELERATION & MECHANICAL ARREST ==================== *)
        (* SIL 4 Ultimate Safety State: Dynamic Braking & Mechanical Wedging *)
        bRouteLockedMain        := FALSE;
        bRouteLockedBranch      := FALSE;
        bMotionInProgress       := FALSE;
        bTraj_Active            := FALSE;
        
        (* Rapid Controlled Deceleration via Inverter Regenerative Dynamic Braking *)
        rEStopBrakeTimer_s := rEStopBrakeTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        
        IF rEStopBrakeTimer_s < 0.250 THEN
            (* Deceleration slope: zero velocity command with max motor braking torque *)
            rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
            rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
            rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
            rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
        ELSE
            (* Drop mechanical spring-applied friction calipers and wedge deadbolts *)
            rServoCmd_Act1_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
            rServoCmd_Act2_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
            rServoCmd_Act3_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
            rServoCmd_Act4_Velocity_mms := 0.0;
            
            (* Lock pins driven down in place to freeze current mechanical geometry *)
            rLockServoCmd_Main_kN   := c_rClampTargetForce_kN;
            rLockServoCmd_Branch_kN := c_rClampTargetForce_kN;
        END_IF;

        (* Alarm Reset Sequence: Requires manual supervisory push-button and healthy safety circuits *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStopOk AND (wAlarmCode_HighSeverity = 0) THEN
            rEStopBrakeTimer_s := 0.000;
            rPOSTTimer_s       := 0.000;
            iState             := 0; (* Re-enter Power-On Self-Test *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Catch-all safe trap *)
        iState := 999;

END_CASE;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   BLOCK 9: OPERATIONAL STATUS WORD & DIAGNOSTIC MAPPING
   Encodes real-time state machine flags into a standard 16-bit status word.
==================================================================================================================== *)
wStatusCode.0  := (iState = 10);                (* Bit 0: Route Locked Main Permissive *)
wStatusCode.1  := (iState = 70);                (* Bit 1: Route Locked Branch Permissive *)
wStatusCode.2  := bMotionInProgress;            (* Bit 2: Trajectory Traversal Active *)
wStatusCode.3  := (ABS(rAlignmentError_SubMm) <= c_rAlignTol_Fine_mm); (* Bit 3: Sub-Millimeter Tolerance Satisfied *)
wStatusCode.4  := bLaserInterferometerHealthy;  (* Bit 4: 2oo3 Laser Interferometers Healthy *)
wStatusCode.5  := bDegradedModeActive;          (* Bit 5: Single-Actuator Limp Mode Active *)
wStatusCode.6  := bTrainApproachingInhibit;     (* Bit 6: Train Proximity Inhibit Active *)
wStatusCode.7  := (rChamberPressure_mbar >= c_rMinVacuumPressure_mbar) AND
